rules: a high indexDelta is a suspicion signal, not proof of a bug
zero local target history is local parser evidence only, not proof the entity never existed in game
cursor/index consistency weakens but does not eliminate unknown semantics
nearby offset alternatives strengthen cursor/command suspicion but do not authorize a fix
payloadBits divergence strengthens payload contract suspicion but does not authorize skip
the probe must fail closed and must not continue after missing entity
all classifications remain diagnostic and must carry explicit limitations
claimsExplicitlyForbidden: permission for recovery, skip, placeholder, parser fix, or canonical output
